summary:
[  edit  ]
The Import Select  SOP  is used to import and load the geometry types primitives defined in  USD COMP  and  FBX COMP . It essentially loads any geometry type that  USD COMP  or  FBX COMP  can support such as a Mesh, Points, NURBS Curves or Patches, Basis Curves. Each geometry represents one primitive from the loading file or it can be a set of primitives merged together for better performance.
In  USD COMP  and  FBX COMP  if the Import Select  SOP  renders merged geometries, an  Info DAT  operator is created next to this  SOP  which represents the original paths of primitives within/from importing file, which can be useful for user to checkout what geometry the current  SOP  is made of.
Import Select  SOP  can have its own animation controls within the Playback page or use the settings from its parent  COMP .
The imported geometry can be loaded directly from  GPU  or CPU, depending on whether the Straight To  GPU  toggle is set to ON or not at the parent  COMP  node.

parameters.label: Import  Parent
parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Specify the import parent (eg. USD/FBX  COMP ) to search for the asset. When no  COMP  is specified it will by default search in the first import parent in its path.

parameters.label: Geo  Path
parameters.name: geometry
parameters.description: The geometry path from the imported file.

parameters.label: Reload
parameters.name: reload
parameters.description: Reloads the asset from the import parent.

parameters.label: Compute Tangents
parameters.name: comptang
parameters.description: A toggle to compute the tangents for this  SOP .

parameters.label: Use Parent Animation
parameters.name: useparentanim
parameters.description: A toggle to specify whether to use the parent  COMP  animation controls or have a custom setting for this  SOP .

parameters.label: Shift Animation Start
parameters.name: shiftanimationstart
parameters.description: A toggle to specify whether to shift the animation to the start of animation indicated in the importing file.

parameters.label: Sample Rate  Mode
parameters.name: sampleratemode
parameters.description: ⊞  - A menu to choose between the  FPS  or use a custom sample rate.

parameters.label: File  FPS
parameters.name: filefps
parameters.description: uses the  FPS  from what is defined in the importing file.

parameters.label: Custom
parameters.name: custom
parameters.description: a desired value specified by  Sample Rate  parameter.

parameters.label: Sample Rate
parameters.name: samplerate
parameters.description: It is used to specify the sample rate ( FPS ) for the animation. This parameter is disabled by default and can be enabled once the Custom option is selected from the  Sample Rate  Menu.

parameters.label: Play Mode
parameters.name: playmode
parameters.description: ⊞  - A menu to specify the method used to play the animation.

parameters.label: Locked to  Timeline
parameters.name: lockedtotimeline
parameters.description: This mode locks the animation position to the timeline. The parameters Play, Speed, Index, Cue and Cue  Point , are disabled in this mode since the timeline is directly tied to animation position.

parameters.label: Specify Index
parameters.name: specifyindex
parameters.description: This mode allows the user to specify a particular index (position) in the animation using the Index parameter below. Use this mode for random access to any location in the animation.

parameters.label: Sequential
parameters.name: sequential
parameters.description: This mode continually plays regardless of the timeline position (the Index parameter is disabled). Play, Speed, Cue, and Cue Point parameters below are enabled to allow some control. The default is set to this value.

parameters.label: Initialize
parameters.name: initialize
parameters.description: Resets the animation to its initial state.

parameters.label: Start
parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Resets the animation to its initial state and starts playback.

parameters.label: Cue
parameters.name: cue
parameters.description: A toggle to jump to Cue Point when it is set to ON and it stays at that position. Only available when Play Mode is Sequential.

parameters.label: Cue  Pulse
parameters.name: cuepulse
parameters.description: When pressed the animation jumps to the Cue Point and continues from that point.

parameters.label: Cue  Point
parameters.name: cuepoint
parameters.description: Set any index in the animation as a point to jump to.

parameters.label: Cue Point Unit
parameters.name: cuepointunit
parameters.description: ⊞  - Specifies a unit type for Cue  Point . Changing this will convert the previous unit to the selected unit.

parameters.label: Play
parameters.name: play
parameters.description: A toggle that makes the animation to play when it sets to ON. This Parameter is only available/enabled if the Sequential mode is selected from the Play Mode.

parameters.label: Index
parameters.name: index
parameters.description: This parameter explicitly sets the animation position when Play Mode is set to Specify Index. The units’ menu on the right lets you specify the index in the following units: Index, Frames, Seconds, and Fraction (percentage).

parameters.label: Index Unit
parameters.name: indexunit
parameters.description: ⊞  - Specifies a unit type for Index. Changing this will convert the previous unit to the selected unit.

parameters.label: Speed
parameters.name: speed
parameters.description: This is a speed multiplier which only works when Play Mode is Sequential. A value of 1 is the default playback speed. A value of 2 is double speed, 0.5 is half speed and so on.

parameters.label: Trim
parameters.name: trim
parameters.description: A toggle to enable the Trim Start and Trim End parameters.

parameters.label: Trim Start
parameters.name: tstart
parameters.description: Sets an in point from the beginning of the animation, allowing you to trim the starting index of the animation. The units’ menu on the right let you specify this position by index, frames, seconds, or fraction (percentage).

parameters.label: Trim Start Unit
parameters.name: tstartunit
parameters.description: ⊞  - Specifies a unit type for Trim Start. Changing this will convert the previous unit to the selected unit.

parameters.label: Trim End
parameters.name: tend
parameters.description: Sets an end point from the end of the movie, allowing you to trim the ending index of the animation. The units’ menu on the right let you specify this position by index, frames, seconds, or fraction (percentage).

parameters.label: Trim End Unit
parameters.name: tendunit
parameters.description: ⊞  - Specifies a unit type for Trim End. Changing this will convert the previous unit to the selected unit.

parameters.label: Extend Left
parameters.name: textendleft
parameters.description: ⊞  - Determines how the parent  COMP  handles animation positions that lie before the Trim Start position. For example, if Trim Start is set to 1, and the animation current index is -10, the Extend Left menu determines how the animation position is calculated.

parameters.label: Extend Right
parameters.name: textendright
parameters.description: ⊞  - Determines how the parent  COMP  handles animation positions that lie after the Trim End position. For example, if Trim End is set to 20, and the animation current index is 25, the Extend Right menu determines how the animation position is calculated.

parameters.label: num_points
parameters.description: Number of points in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_prims
parameters.description: Number of primitives in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_particles
parameters.description: Number of particles in this  SOP .

parameters.label: last_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating geometry data on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: last_meta_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating meta surface geometry data (such as metaballs or nurbs) on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.
